aboutSubtitleTechnical: Your Voice. Your Truth. Protected by Design.
missionPara1: VocalWitness na simple public square where anybody fit share wetin dem see or experience — with proof say e never change.
missionPara2: For world wey full of edited videos and fake news, we give ordinary people safe place to publish photos, voice notes and reports. Everything dey protected so the evidence go remain trustworthy and your privacy go remain intact.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Every photo, voice note and document get unique digital fingerprint for your device before upload. Others fit confirm say e real without seeing your private details.
privacyFirstDesc: To speak out na always your choice. We automatically remove location and device information. Phone checks na only temporary to stop spam and dem never store publicly.
communityStewardshipDesc: No single person decide wetin be true. Trust dey grow through honest participation and clear reputation. We stay neutral.
communitySupportedDesc: VocalWitness dey keep alive by voluntary support. No ads, no paywalls, and no premium features locked behind payment.
trustStep1Desc: Everybody begin as Citizen. You fit raise your level with simple checks. Higher levels unlock stronger protection.
trustStep2Desc: Once something publish, e dey lock. Nobody fit quietly change or delete the original.
trustStep3Desc: VocalWitness na neutral public square. We no edit posts or push certain stories. The evidence dey speak for itself.
aboutQuote: "For the age of noise, the clearest voice na the one wey fit prove say e never alter."
privacySubtitle: Your privacy dey protected by strong technology — no be just promises.
zkSubpoenaTitle: We No Fit Give Wetin We No Get
zkSubpoenaDesc: VocalWitness dey build so your personal identity never reach our servers. If any authority ask for your private information, our answer simple: We no get anything to give.
privacySec1Title: 1. Everything Important Happen for Your Device
privacySec1Para1: When you upload photo, voice note or document, the sensitive work dey do inside your own browser before anything leave your device:
privacySec1Bullet1: Metadata dey remove: Camera model, GPS location and other private details dey automatically strip.
privacySec1Bullet2: Digital fingerprint dey create: Your browser make unique fingerprint of the file. Only this and the cleaned media dey send.
privacySec1Bullet3: Strong verification: You fit prove say you be real person without revealing private identity details.
privacySec2Title: 2. Wetin We Never Collect or Store
privacySec2Intro: For maximum safety we deliberately no keep:
privacySec2Item1: Your real IP address — requests pass through protection layers so your location no link to your posts.
privacySec2Item2: Phone numbers for any public record — phone checks na only temporary to stop spam and dem never save or show.
privacySec2Item3: Government IDs, passports, biometrics, or your personal contact list.
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Your chosen username, security keys, and any trust badges you earn.
privacyContentDesc: Your reports, cleaned media, digital fingerprints, and timestamps.
privacyVerificationDesc: Proof say you be real person — without revealing who you be.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous technical data wey dem use only to block attacks and bots.
privacySec4Text: Our design follow Articles 12 and 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights: everybody get right to privacy and freedom to share information without interference.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness na only technical host. We no write, approve or fact-check the content people post.
privacySec5Text2: Each person full responsible for wetin dem choose to publish.
privacySec6Title: 6. Wetin No Allowed & How to Report
privacySec6Text1: Harassment, sharing somebody private personal details without consent, child sexual abuse material, and deliberately fake harmful media strictly forbidden.
privacySec6Text2: If you see content wey break these rules, abeg report am using the in-app button.
privacySec7Text: You fit instantly clear your local browser data with the Quick Exit button. However, once report publish and lock, e become permanent record.
privacySec8Text: The VocalWitness platform, including e software, design, name and logo, na exclusive intellectual property of VocalWitness. You no fit copy or reuse am without permission.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — public square where people fit share real reports and evidence with strong protection. By using the platform you agree to these simple rules.
termsSection1Text: By creating account, posting or using VocalWitness, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you no agree, abeg no use the platform.
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness na neutral platform. We give people tools to publish reports and protect evidence. We no be news publisher, we no decide wetin be true, and we no be court of law.
termsSection3Intro: To keep the square safe from bots and spam, we use simple levels of verification:
termsTier1: Open Talk — Open to everybody wey sign up. Basic public discussion.
termsTier2: Citizen Circle — Unlock with temporary phone check (use only to stop spam). Your phone number never save publicly.
termsTier3: Higher Trust / Verified Reports — Highest level. Your media get digital fingerprint for your device, private details remove, and stronger protection apply.
termsSection4Intro: You stay in control of your voice. Here be the clear rules:
termsConduct1: Your Choice: You decide whether to speak publicly or stay more private.
termsConduct2: Be Honest: Only post reports and evidence you genuinely believe be true.
termsConduct3: No Doxxing or Harassment: No share other people private details. Targeted harassment no allowed.
termsConduct4: No Fake or Harmful Content: Creating deepfakes to harm somebody strictly forbidden.
termsSection5Text: You keep full ownership of everything you post. By publishing, you give VocalWitness permission to store and display your content. Once lock, e become part of permanent record.
termsSection6Text: We use trusted global services for secure storage and protection against attacks. The platform dey provide “as is”.
termsSection7Text: The platform dey support by voluntary donations. Donations no give anybody special control or ownership.
termsSection8Text: To the fullest extent wey law allow, VocalWitness no responsible for indirect damages wey arise from use of the platform or content wey users post.
termsSection9Title: 9. Your Responsibility for Wetin You Post
termsSection9Text: You responsible for wetin you publish. If somebody get problem with content, dem should use our reporting process.
termsSection10Text: All rights for the VocalWitness platform, including e software, design, name and logo, remain the exclusive property of VocalWitness.
termsSection10Text2: You no fit copy, modify or commercially exploit any part of the platform without written permission.
divineNaturalLawTitle: Your Right to Speak the Truth
divineNaturalLawDesc: Every person get the right to share wetin dem witness. This dey protect under Article 19 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
subpoenaDefenseDesc: We no fit give away information wey we never collect. Your identity stay protected.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: No identity logs wey link to your public posts.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: Location and device details dey remove for your browser before upload.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Strong technical protection for anonymous reporters.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Extra Safety Tips for High-Risk Situations
networkSafetySubDesc: For restrictive areas, use Tor or trusted VPN. Avoid publishing for networks wey link to your official ID.
physicalSafetySubDesc: Use strong passcode. If you feel danger, press the red Quick Exit button — e clear local data and leave the site.
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Sharing somebody private details without permission.
safetyProhibit3: Fake or Altered Evidence wey mean to harm others.
safetySection4Title: 4. How We Keep the Community Safe
safetySection4Text: Safety come from community reporting and clear verification levels:
safetyModTier1: Open Talk — Open discussion for everybody.
safetyModTier2: Higher Trust — Stronger protection and reputation.
safetyGoalText: Safe public square where real reports fit share and people dey protect by design.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once report publish, the rules make am extremely hard for anybody to edit or delete the original.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Database rules block updates and deletes on the record.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Digital fingerprints dey create for your device.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Records dey link together for extra protection.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important: This na strong application-level protection, no be full public blockchain. The data live for secure cloud storage.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Future option: We fit add extra public anchoring. This no yet active.
